key_requirements: Aligns national law with GDPR, data subject rights, supervisory powers
deceased_data: No specific national rules on deceased persons' data (GDPR recital 27: living persons only); professional secrecy still applies
research_exemption: Scientific/historical research and statistics: special categories without consent and limits on GDPR arts. 15, 16, 18, 21 rights (art. 27 DSG); public-interest archiving rules; art. 89 GDPR
genetic_data: Special category under art. 9 GDPR (applies via EEA); DSG art. 27 allows processing for research without consent under conditions
notes: LGBl. 2018 No. 272; fully revised prior law; GDPR applies in EEA since 20 July 2018
